structure.description: 画面以两条水平线和两条垂直线分为九宫，焦点落在交点或分割线上。

subject_rules.primary: place the subject on one rule-of-thirds intersection, never dead center

visual_flow.primary: from the nearest grid intersection through the subject
visual_flow.secondary: along the horizon or nearest third line

generation.style: subject-led visual storytelling; retain the chosen medium and avoid a house art style
